items.text: Earlierin thistopicwementioned thefact that the contributionto the hydrogenion concentrationfrom the dissociation of water can usually be ignored. When solutions are as dilute as 10-8mol dm-3 this is no longer the case. The pH of 10-8 mol dm-3 hydrochloric acid is very close to 7, as the contribution to the concentration of hydrogen ions from the water(10-7mol dm-3) is now greater than that of the acid.
